_note: Curated SCM/Operations fellowships, competitions, hackathons, LDPs and associations for a supply-chain / operations graduate student (f1_ok marks F-1 friendliness). Verify live dates each fall. Last researched 2026-06.

case_competitions.name: TCU Graduate Supply Chain Case Competition
case_competitions.eligibility: Invitation-only at program level; full-time MS/MBA. No citizenship restriction. Ask whether your program is already invited.
case_competitions.desc: Strongest, most accessible fit. Prizes $14K/$10K/$6K. Tell your program's faculty / supply chain club early in the fall.

case_competitions.name: GM / WSU Supply Chain Case Competition
case_competitions.org: Wayne State (Ilitch), sponsored by General Motors
case_competitions.timeline: Oct 22-24, 2026 (in-person Detroit). Invite-only: one team of up to 4 per school, registered by a faculty advisor — ask your faculty early (verified on wayne.edu, 2026-09-27)

case_competitions.name: ASCM Student Case Competition
case_competitions.timeline: 2026 finals Sept 29-30 (Long Beach) — this year's school/regional rounds are over. Plan for the 2027 cycle; check ascm.org (couldn't verify automatically)
case_competitions.eligibility: Undergrad + grad, teams of 4 + faculty advisor. No citizenship restriction.
case_competitions.desc: Check via your school's ASCM student chapter in the fall.

case_competitions.name: ISM Student Case Competition
case_competitions.eligibility: Teams ≤4, full-time undergrad/grad. No citizenship restriction stated.

hackathons_datathons.name: Kaggle — Store Sales: Time Series Forecasting
hackathons_datathons.desc: Canonical retail demand-forecasting portfolio project. Start today — directly SCM-relevant.

hackathons_datathons.name: GS3 — Global Sustainability Supply Chain Student Competition
hackathons_datathons.eligibility: Team-based, online, ~$50/student entry. No travel required.
hackathons_datathons.desc: Most directly SCM-specific team competition; online, no travel.

hackathons_datathons.name: Kaggle Competitions (broader)
hackathons_datathons.desc: Watch for forecasting/tabular challenges (e.g. M5 Walmart-style).

hackathons_datathons.name: DrivenData Competitions
hackathons_datathons.desc: Social-impact/logistics data challenges. Good secondary platform.

rotational_ldps.name: Microsoft — Supply Chain & Operations
rotational_ldps.eligibility: One of largest US H1B sponsors; strongest sponsorship track record.

rotational_ldps.name: Amazon — Pathways Operations Leadership & Supply Chain
rotational_ldps.desc: Operations leadership; Pathways targets advanced-degree holders.

rotational_ldps.name: PepsiCo — Supply Chain Leadership Development Program
rotational_ldps.eligibility: Historically sponsors; some postings restrict — verify per posting. Best CPG bet.

rotational_ldps.name: Johnson & Johnson — Operations (SCM) LDP
rotational_ldps.eligibility: MIXED — some J&J LDP postings explicitly state NO sponsorship. Verify each.
rotational_ldps.desc: Rotational across planning, manufacturing, procurement, logistics.

rotational_ldps.name: Starbucks — Supply Chain (Seattle HQ)
rotational_ldps.eligibility: Sponsors some corporate roles; no dedicated visa-sponsoring SCM LDP confirmed.

rotational_ldps.name: Target — Supply Chain / Operations Leadership
rotational_ldps.eligibility: Ops/distribution roles frequently require work auth without future sponsorship.

rotational_ldps.name: Boeing — Supply Chain / Operations rotationals
rotational_ldps.eligibility: HARD BLOCKER: defense contractor, most roles require US citizen/PR (ITAR).
rotational_ldps.tier: Tier 3 — generally not viable for F1
rotational_ldps.desc: Most ops/SCM roles need US-Person status.

fellowships.name: AWESOME Excellence in Education Scholarship
fellowships.eligibility: Women in full-time SCM programs; no citizenship requirement. RISK: may be undergrad-only — EMAIL TO CONFIRM grad eligibility.
fellowships.desc: $5,000 + AWESOME Symposium + CSCMP EDGE attendance. Only women-specific fellowship not obviously ruled out.

associations.name: ASCM (formerly APICS) Student Membership
associations.eligibility: FREE student membership. Open to all enrolled students.
associations.desc: Top no-cost pick. Discounts on CPIM/CSCP/CLTD + case competition access.

associations.name: ASCM local chapter
associations.eligibility: Local cert training + networking + facility tours
associations.desc: Find the chapter for your area through ascm.org; local cert training, networking and facility tours. Verify current calendar.

associations.name: CSCMP Student Membership
associations.desc: Includes EDGE conference pricing + local roundtable access.

associations.name: INFORMS Student Membership
associations.desc: Best for OR/analytics/optimization side of SCM.
